model_annotation: The figure contains two side-by-side grouped bar charts titled “Deutschland” and “EU,” illustrating percentage values for three metals (Aluminium, Kupfer, Nickel) across three years (2021, 2022, 2023). In both panels, the horizontal axis lists the categories Aluminium, Kupfer, and Nickel in that left-to-right order, and the vertical axis is labeled “%” with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 30 with tick marks at 5-unit intervals. Each category has three adjacent bars corresponding to the legend: 2021 in blue, 2022 in purple, and 2023 in light gray, with numeric value labels above each bar. In the EU panel, Aluminium shows 3.2%, 2.8%, and 1.7%; Kupfer shows 4.4%, 5.1%, and 1.3%; Nickel shows 24.3%, 23.3%, and 14.6%. The bars are grouped by metal rather than sorted by height, and no bars appear specially emphasized beyond the consistent color coding and the value annotations.
